main_text.l: Fiebant olim laternæ ex cornu, & quandoque ex vesicâ. Amph. 1. 1. v. 184. Vulcanum in cornu conclusum geris. Martial lib. 14. Epig. 62. vocantur duces viarum : & Noctilucæ. Lycophronis interpres Zezes tradit Prometheum fuisse primum Authorem laternarum è cornu factarum. De laternis furdis videndus Isaacus Casaubonus Animadversiones in Sueton. pag. 26. Et prolixè Martinus de Roa de omni usu Laternarum lib. 2. Singular. Locor. cap. 22.
Lucerna filinteum unctum defit, exstinguitur. Bacch. 3. 3. v. 42.
Laternæ Africanæ supra cæteros erant pellucidæ, propter cornu, quod erat lucidius, & nitidius. Aul. 3. 6. v. 29. Ita is pellucet, quasi laterna Punica.
Ebrii & saturi facii petebant secessus. Curc. 2. 3. v. 84.

page.notes: Ornament between sections omitted. Text in red and italic partly rendered as printed; "Fiebant", "Ebrii" initials are large capitals. Some words in the Lycophron and Casaubonus lines are uncertain at the scan's edge.
